purpose: Non-destructive Neon recovery and remediation procedure for canonical Atlas state.
preconditions: Confirm Atlas production reports Neon healthy enough to inspect or degraded with a concrete failure mode.
Never run recovery proof work directly against the production main branch.
Prefer disposable branch-based validation before any remediation touching canonical state.

steps.action: Read Atlas production system health and capture the current Neon status and timestamp.
Create a disposable Neon branch from main for recovery proof work.
Confirm the proof branch receives its own active compute surface.
Capture project id, parent branch id, proof branch id, compute id, timestamps, and operator.
Delete the disposable proof branch after verification to prove reversibility.

rollback_and_safety.cleanup_action: Delete the disposable proof branch after evidence capture.
escalate_when: A restore requires writing to main.
Point-in-time recovery needs operator approval or a higher-risk data change.
